definitions.explanation: An additional issue of a magazine or periodical published outside the regular schedule, often on a specific theme.

examples.japanese: {増刊|ぞうかん}{号|ごう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{増刊|ぞうかん}{号|ごう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: The special issue of that magazine comes out every summer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{特集|とくしゅう}→特集：13468_tokushuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}んだ→組む：02050_kumu⟧{増刊|ぞうかん}{号|ごう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{売|う}り{切|き}れた→売り切れる：03012_urikireru⟧。
examples.english: The special issue featuring the popular series sold out quickly.

notes:
Literally "additional publication" — an extra issue published between regular editions of a magazine. Common in manga magazines and hobby publications, where {増刊|ぞうかん}{号|ごう} may feature special content, bonus chapters, or themed collections.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {増刊|ぞうかん}{号|ごう}: special/extra issue
- ⟦{臨時|りんじ}→臨時：04092_rinji⟧{増刊|ぞうかん}: special extra edition
- {増刊|ぞうかん}{号|ごう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to publish a special issue

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{別冊|べっさつ}→別冊：17146_bessatsu⟧: separate volume/supplement — a standalone publication spun off from a magazine
- ⟦{臨時|りんじ}→臨時：04092_rinji⟧{号|ごう}: special/emergency edition — broader than {増刊|ぞうかん}, can apply to newspapers too
- ⟦{特集|とくしゅう}→特集：13468_tokushuu⟧: feature/special — a themed section within a regular issue
